Introduction
This document outlines the monthly maintenance steps I1, M1, for the Ziegler Ultra Power TS 8/8 portable fire-fighting pump, which is the pump used in fire-fighting in emergency cases; there are 2 pumps.
Technical specifications:
With Volks Wagen polo-4-stroke Aluminum Engine
Tested According to GERMAN DIN Standard 14410 and 14420 (PVR 380/4/97)
Technical data:-
Nominal output : 800 l/min at 8 bar and 3 m geodesic suction height
Pump output : at 1.5 m suction height. Approx. 2150 l/min at 4 bar
: at 3 m suction height. 
Approx. 1950 l/min at 6 bar
Approx. 1800 l/min at 8 
bar
Approx. 1500 l/min 
at 10 bar
: at 7.5 m suction height Approx. 1050 l/min .at 8 bar
Dimension ( l x w x h ) : 1085 mm x 740 mm x 830 mm
Weight : 189 kg.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Rify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment.
Those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment ( safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves ..... ).
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically.
Close the suction and discharge valves.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete tool bag
Pump-specific tools
Suitable lifting device for the pump
Cleaning fluid, rags, 
 Straight edge
Procedures to be Carried Out
1. | Check the engine oil temperature and level.
2. | Check the petrol pump of the pump.
3. | Inspect the alarms from the auxiliary control panel and the main control panel.
4. | Make sure of the suction and discharge hoses in the pump, as well as all their connections.
5. | Inspect any leaks from the suction and discharge valves.
